risk: Unhandled giic_OrderTypeCode__c leads to EscalationEndEvent terminating with RoutingConditionNotMet
consequence: Sales orders or return orders with new or unmapped order types are terminated immediately without notification sent to sender or dead-letter queuing.
mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_SO_003 asserts that the default route triggers the escalation code explicitly, validating that monitoring alerts can trigger on 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.

risk: Unconnected BPMN activities (CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86) left orphan in flow model
consequence: Validation script 'GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy' and XPath extraction for OrganizationId are never invoked, creating false confidence in logic validation.
mitigation: Coverage analysis documents these orphan nodes; test suite verifies behavior with and without script evaluation to identify gaps.

risk: Inbound SOAP message payload buffering in property '${in.body}' causing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) on large payloads
consequence: High-volume batches or large notification bodies cached in Java heap property InputPayload can cause JVM heap exhaustion and cluster node restarts.
mitigation: MessageFlow SOAP adapter limits maximumBodySize to 40MB; Exception Subprocess TC_GLOVIA_SO_004 ensures memory recovery during parsing failures.

risk: OneWay SOAP pattern prevents sender from receiving synchronous fault or escalation details
consequence: Glovia sender receives HTTP 202 acknowledgment while downstream flow fails silently in ErrorEndEvent or EscalationEndEvent.
mitigation: Exception Subprocess (SubProcess_91) logs raw payload via Log_Payload.gsh for manual operational replay via MPL attachments.
